events.label: Kentucky appeals panel dissolves TRO for Thomas Castellanos

slots.name: panel size
slots.sentence: Castellanos, who joined the Red Raiders on a temporary injunction back in August, was ruled ineligible on Friday after a panel of three judges from the Kentucky Court of Appeals sided with the NCAA in dissolving the TRO that the Florida State transfer had previously received from a judge in the state of Kentucky.
